about.id: Saya fullstack developer yang fokus pada problem solving, reliability sistem, dan implementasi produk dari database sampai UI. Saya terbiasa mengerjakan flow kompleks seperti auth, role access, transaksi, webhook, integrasi AI, dan deployment.
about.en: I am a fullstack developer focused on problem solving, system reliability, and end-to-end product implementation from database to UI. I am experienced with complex flows such as auth, RBAC, transactions, webhooks, AI integration, and deployment.

pitch_30s.id: Saya membangun aplikasi operasional bisnis yang practical, scalable, dan siap production. Project utama saya, Cuanify, menggabungkan POS, inventory, payment gateway, analytics, dan AI assistant dalam satu platform.
pitch_30s.en: I build practical, scalable, production-ready business operation apps. My main project, Cuanify, combines POS, inventory, payment gateway, analytics, and an AI assistant in one platform.
